purpose: Locate process CPU growth by sequential request phase before selecting another C7a scaling mechanism.
audit: Removal of the diagnostic insertions recovers three production call-site files byte for byte.

recorder.allocation: Fixed process-global buffer; one active diagnostic request; snapshots and formatting outside request timers.
recorder.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC brackets RUSAGE_SELF calls; timed perf samples inside clock brackets are excluded as boundary-ambiguous.
recorder.thread_scope: All process threads; caller migration is recorded by Linux TID. Concurrent app requests are outside scope.

validity.phase_sequence: Exactly16 ordered stamps per enabled request; none when disabled; no overflow; nonnegative accounting deltas; complete request coverage.
validity.calibration: Describe every OFF/accepted and ON/OFF ratio; flag factors above1.05 OFF/accepted or1.03 ON/OFF forprimary,1.05 ON/OFF formerge54. No latency adoption or unchanged reroll.
validity.samples: One PID, zero lost events; retain out-of-request and ambiguous samples rather than forcing attribution.
validity.reporting: Per-phase process CPU and weighted sampled categories are diagnostic; CPU occupancy includes spinning. No physical96-core scaling claim from local32logicalCPUs.
